outline:
＊提醒:本課程為全英語授課，對學生英語程度要求高，需要經常以英語回答問題，口頭報告並與外籍生互動，期末考也需以全英語作答。 無法達成上述要求可導致無法順利通過本科目。

＊本課程在一般授課時間外，每位同學也需經常到實驗室做實驗，並在課堂上討論實驗結果做為平時成績。


＊Reminder: This is an international students friendly course. Domestic students are required to use full English to answer questions, do the presentation and write exam sheets.

＊In addition to regular class hours, this course requires frequent laboratory experiments. The experimental results will be discussed in class and will count towards the continuous assessment.
schedule:
week 1: Introduction and review of constitutive modeling fundamentals
week 2: Introduction to biochar: Production, properties, and composite applications
week 3: Lab work: Biochar sample preparation and SEM/XRD characterization
week 4: Lab work: FTIR, TGA, and BET surface area analysis for biochar
week 5: MATLAB coding: Data processing for characterization results
week 6: MATLAB coding: Visualization and statistical analysis of biochar properties
week 7: Subroutine code: Material property database design
week 8: Implementation of characterization data into FE material models
week 9: Midterm exam
week 10: Introduction to tensile testing: ASTM/ISO standards and specimen preparation
week 11: PDE constitutive equations for tensile behavior (elastic-plastic response)
week 12: PDE constitutive equations for tensile behavior (damage and fracture)
week 13: MATLAB coding of constitutive equations for tensile behavior
week 14: MATLAB coding of constitutive equations 2 (parameter identification)
week 15: Subroutine code for tensile constitutive models
week 16: Implementation of subroutine code to FE (tensile simulation)
week 17: Summary of course / Repetition
week 18: Final exam(after exam, there will be online discussion)試後線上授課討論
scorePolicy:
labwork, research paper writting, inclass report 50%
midterm exam 25%
final exam 25%
materials: LIN, Jianguo. Fundamentals of materials modelling for metals processing technologies: theories and applications. World Scientific Publishing Company, 2015.
